step-1.text: Lay both side frames on the floor, inside faces up, and sort the shelves from biggest to smallest if they differ.

step-2.text: Screw the bottom shelf and the top shelf to the first frame. Hand tight for now so the frame can still settle.

count-2.text: This step uses 2 shelves and 4 screws.

step-3.text: Bring in the second frame and screw it to the same two shelves. Now it stands as a box.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 side frame and 4 screws.

step-4.text: Fit the middle shelves one by one, two screws each side.

count-4.text: This step uses 3 shelves and 12 screws.

step-5.text: Stand it upright on a flat floor, check it does not rock, and tighten every screw. Adjust the levelling feet if it has them.

count-5.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-6.text: Fix the top to the wall with the anti-tip strap or bracket and screws that suit your wall. Tall shelves always get anchored.

done.text: Done. Your 5-TIER ladder bookshelf is built. Give it a proud little pat.
